title: DeskWing
googleShortDescription: Tablet controls, pen input, notes and a second display for your Windows PC.
description:
Make your tablet an extension of your Windows PC.

DeskWing brings streaming controls, app shortcuts, shared writing and an extra desktop into one tablet workspace.

STREAM AND CONTROL
Build your own pages for OBS scenes, audio, Soundpad, applications, hotkeys and macros. Use large tablet buttons while your PC handles configuration and connected applications.

WRITE AND ORGANIZE
Sketch with a compatible pen, use your system keyboard's handwriting input, and keep notes beside your PC work. The workspace-expansion candidate adds named notebook documents and pages, local PDF annotation, document recovery/history and user-selected export. Shared content travels to the PC you pair with.

DRAW INTO WINDOWS APPS
Use an explicitly enabled pen-input session for supported Windows applications. The interactive-display candidate combines native video with pen or touch input on DeskWing's owned extra monitor. App, brush and hardware compatibility determine the available pressure and tilt behavior.

EXTEND YOUR DESKTOP
View a separately created Windows desktop through native silent H.264 video. Choose 60 Hz or match the tablet's reported current refresh rate. Actual video delivery depends on the PC, resolution, encoder, connection, tablet decoder and power state.

WHAT YOU NEED
A compatible Windows PC with the matching DeskWing Windows companion is required. Use a local Wi-Fi/network connection, or the supported Android USB setup. Independent-display viewing requires a compatible virtual-display driver already installed on the PC and explicit sharing. No driver is bundled. Handwriting requires a compatible pen and system keyboard or Scribble configuration.

PRIVACY AND SUPPORT
Core controls connect directly to your paired PC without a DeskWing cloud account. Optional provider views and release checks contact their respective services. Review the in-app privacy information and public policy for shared document storage, input, capture and export details.
